meta.title: Total crypto market cap, monthly
meta.method: One value per month: the close of the month's last day (UTC). Bitcoin only (Coin Metrics) from July 2010 to March 2013; total crypto market cap (CoinMarketCap) from April 2013. Null where no market price existed or no continuous archive survives. Nothing is interpolated.

eras.infancy: Jan 2009 to Feb 2010: no exchange, no market price.
eras.btc-only: Mar 2010 to Mar 2013: Bitcoin market cap only (data from Jul 2010).
eras.total-market: Apr 2013 onward: total crypto market cap.

sources: Coin Metrics Community Data, btc.csv (CapMrktCurUSD): https://github.com/coinmetrics/data
CoinMarketCap global metrics, total market cap: https://coinmarketcap.com/charts/
